mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, title, description, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.exam_matrices WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, course_id, title, description, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.exam_matrices WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.course_id AS courseId, m.title, m.description, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS rowCount, COALESCE(SUM(c.question_count), 0) AS totalQuestionCount, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM edu.exam_matrices m LEFT JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows r ON r.matrix_id = m.id LEFT JOIN edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts c ON c.exam_matrix_row_id = r.id WHERE m.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT o.exam_matrix_row_id AS examMatrixRowId, o.learning_outcome_id AS learningOutcomeId FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes o JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows r ON r.id = o.exam_matrix_row_id WHERE r.matrix_id = #{matrixId} ORDER BY o.exam_matrix_row_id, o.learning_outcome_id

SELECT c.exam_matrix_row_id AS examMatrixRowId, c.custom_learning_level_id AS customLearningLevelId, l.code, l.name, l.description, l.sort_order AS sortOrder, c.question_count AS questionCount FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts c JOIN edu.custom_learning_levels l ON l.id = c.custom_learning_level_id JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows r ON r.id = c.exam_matrix_row_id WHERE r.matrix_id = #{matrixId} ORDER BY c.exam_matrix_row_id, l.sort_order, l.id

SELECT count_record.exam_matrix_row_id AS examMatrixRowId, count_record.custom_learning_level_id AS customLearningLevelId, mapping.learning_outcome_id AS learningOutcomeId FROM edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts count_record JOIN edu.exam_matrix_rows matrix_row ON matrix_row.id = count_record.exam_matrix_row_id JOIN edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes mapping ON mapping.custom_learning_level_id = count_record.custom_learning_level_id JOIN edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_outcomes row_outcome ON row_outcome.exam_matrix_row_id = count_record.exam_matrix_row_id AND row_outcome.learning_outcome_id = mapping.learning_outcome_id WHERE matrix_row.matrix_id = #{matrixId} ORDER BY count_record.exam_matrix_row_id, count_record.custom_learning_level_id, mapping.learning_outcome_id
SELECT id, course_id AS courseId, code, name, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM edu.custom_learning_levels WHERE id IN #{id}

SELECT custom_learning_level_id AS customLearningLevelId, learning_outcome_id AS learningOutcomeId FROM edu.custom_learning_level_learning_outcomes WHERE custom_learning_level_id IN #{id} ORDER BY custom_learning_level_id, learning_outcome_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.exam_matrices (id, course_id, title, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO edu.exam_matrix_rows (id, matrix_id, chapter_id, topic, order_index) VALUES (#{id}, #{matrixId}, #{chapterId}, #{topic}, #{orderIndex})
INSERT INTO edu.exam_matrix_row_learning_level_counts (exam_matrix_row_id, custom_learning_level_id, question_count) VALUES (#{rowId}, #{count.customLearningLevelId}, #{count.questionCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.exam_matrices SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE edu.exam_matrices SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edu.exam_matrix_rows WHERE matrix_id = #{matrixId} AND id = #{rowId}
